item_verdicts.diff: read commit 7f0275c48 against base a8d228247; one commit, three files, 218 insertions and 1 deletion — the new gateEvidenceIsReference grammar and the GateTable branch in docs/ui/plan.jsx, a 162-line test module, and a 19-line landed-report fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for a test that renders a prose-evidence gate with no link and a reference-evidence gate that links to the anchor; tests/test_gate_evidence_renders_as_written.py:122 and :138 assert exactly those two cases over the plan view's own GateTable, and I re-ran the file at head 7f0275c48 (6 passed, EXIT=0, review-head-gate.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that docs/ui/plan.jsx render a gate's evidence as a link only when the value parses as an anchor reference and as text when it is prose; docs/ui/plan.jsx:184 now branches on gateEvidenceIsReference(gate.evidence), linking a reference and rendering prose in span.r-gate-evidence-prose, matching the goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commit 7f0275c48, both gate arms with their logs (base a8d228247 86 passed/19 skipped, head 7f0275c48 92 passed/19 skipped), the negative-control log, and the module-eval rationale; its account matches the diff and logs I read.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; git diff a8d228247 7f0275c48 touches only docs/ui/plan.jsx, tests/test_gate_evidence_renders_as_written.py and docs/evidence/fragments/lane-and-model-routing/gate-evidence-renders-as-written.html, all inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the reviewed negative control (negative-control.log) reinstates the unconditional <a href> and reddens the three prose-evidence tests (EXIT=1), and because the new tests extract the grammar and GateTable from docs/ui/plan.jsx a revert also makes tests/test_gate_evidence_renders_as_written.py:52 raise, so the guard fails on the regression it guards.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_gate_evidence_renders_as_written.py renders the plan view's own GateTable through tests/spa_module_eval.py and its 6 tests pass at head (review-head-gate.log 6 passed, EXIT=0; the run's head.log 92 passed/19 skipped), though the render is the module element tree rather than a DOM.
justifications.fit: the new test follows the existing tests/spa_module_eval.evaluate_jsx_module idiom used by five peers (tests/test_spa_plan_checklist.py, tests/test_spa_dag_layout.py), and the added names carry no plan, version or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/ui/plan.jsx:181-188 links only a value gateEvidenceIsReference accepts and renders prose as span.r-gate-evidence-prose, which is exactly the §11 goal.
justifications.reuse: no client-side reference-grammar owner exists; the grammar mirrors reckon/_schema.py:229-234's _REF_SEGMENT/_PROJECT_SEGMENT and the comment names that owner, so the addition extends a capability the repository owns rather than forking an unrelated one.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a8d228247 7f0275c48 --name-status is exactly the three declared paths, with no other SPA module and no Python source touched.
